appearance.title: Interface Theme
appearance.theme_desc: Choose the visual style of the Grape console. Liquid Glass features a frosted sidebar, system font stack, refined corners and pill buttons for a clean, transparent feel.
appearance.mode_desc: Liquid Glass only — follows system dark/light preference.

language.title: Language
language.desc: Select the interface language. The page will refresh automatically.

pipeline.title: Pipeline Mode
pipeline.plugin_desc: Plugin mode: uses pipelines.json + tag broadcast preemption, tasks enqueued by pool_tag, idle engines claim_by_tag.
pipeline.traditional_desc: Traditional mode: uses agent-skill-mapping.json + runtime_id binding, tasks assigned directly to specific engines.
pipeline.warning: ⚠️ Takes effect immediately, affecting dispatch for all subsequent new events. In-progress tasks are unaffected.

credentials.huawei_cloud_desc: Huawei Cloud CodeArts provides free cloud dev environment for Coding Agent.
credentials.bot_token_placeholder_empty: Not set, will use Grape official bot by default
credentials.user_token_placeholder: User token active, no separate config needed
credentials.global_bot_placeholder: Using global bot token, no separate config needed

host.title: Hosted Repositories
host.unhost_warning: ⚠️ After unhosting, all asset data for this repository on Grape (events, sessions, Agent configs, repo skills, workspace files) will be deleted and cannot be recovered.
host.confirm_remove:
⚠️ Are you sure you want to unhost {{name}}?

This will wipe ALL related data for this repository on Grape (Issues Center cards, pipeline/event records, project knowledge baseline, scene bindings, sessions, Agent configs, repo skills, workspace files). This cannot be undone.

Please proceed with caution if you need to keep historical data.
host.migrate_desc: Migrate the repo from the current org to a target org (use after the repo has been transferred on GitCode). Webhook/bot config is preserved (not rebuilt); scene/issue history follows the migration.
host.migrate_confirm:
Are you sure you want to migrate the repo to {{target}}?

This will atomically rewrite repo_key and all associated data (hosting, scenes, issues, knowledge baseline, workspace dir). Webhook/bot config is preserved.
